news.headline: Russia strikes Ukrainian cities, Poland scrambles fighter jets
news.summary:
Russian air strikes killed at least eight people in Ukraine on Thursday, including one in Kyiv, in attacks extending as far as the western city of Lviv, forcing neighbouring Poland to scramble fighter jets to secure its airspace.
The attacks come as President Volodymyr Zelensky returns from the Unit

news.headline: New dinosaur discovered in Zimbabwe
news.summary: The Musango matusadonaensis species discovered in Zimbabwe has revealed diversity of dinosaurs in southern Africa.

news.headline: War and shortages push Gaza hospitals to breaking point
news.summary: Gaza’s collapsing health system leaves dialysis patients, amputees and trauma survivors without vital care.

news.headline: Uefa to hold emergency meeting over Fifa World Cup plans
news.summary: European football's governing body Uefa will hold a meeting of all 55 member associations on Thursday afternoon to discuss its response to Fifa's controversial World Cup plans.
